claim_scope: One exact reproducible local installation archive, built from current compiler output, installed and exercised twice outside the checkout without package dependencies or hidden workspace imports.
changes: The clean-package validator accepts an explicit absolute pinned TypeScript compiler instead of requiring a checkout-relative node_modules path.
The validator builds two isolated archives and requires exact filename, size, shasum, integrity, file inventory and SHA-256 equality.
The shipped-file and installed-export checks include the reconciled three-language compiler and all three explicit migration helpers.
The refreshed archive includes the R17 user guide and installed reconciled commerce example; R17 separately owns their executable acceptance evidence.
residuals: The package contains 1395 entries and unpacks to 12.86 MB because current TypeScript compilation emits source maps, declaration maps and internal verification modules and R17 adds one complete installed example; the compressed archive is 2.57 MB. Payload minimization is not required for correctness and was not mixed into R16.
Native TypeScript, Python, Rust and Lean toolchains remain explicit verification prerequisites; they are not undeclared npm dependencies.
R17 owns user-facing documentation and installed execution of the selected reconciled three-language commerce corpus.
